headline: Last Warden Post on Fisherman's Row Falls as Expanse Deadlocks
war_summary: Since our last edition the map has shifted along several coasts. Fisherman's Row's final Warden post has fallen, leaving all nine of its bases under Colonial colors, and Farranac Coast likewise stands wholly Colonial after the day's fighting about Transient Valley. The Linn of Mercy, lately settled, has broken silence again: one post now lies demolished in no-man's-land, with Lathair and Rotdust the busiest ground and action logged up to the minute of this dispatch. The Weathered Expanse has evened at four bases apiece with one in ruin, Crow's Nest the storm-center of twenty-one recorded actions in a day, its casualty ledger climbing at a fierce rate. In Stonecradle the flags have not moved since early morning, yet Buckler Sound has traded blows twelve times and the day's losses run past twenty-five thousand. The Gutter's Parras post changed hands repeatedly into the evening, while Stlican Shelf holds at five Warden to four Colonial. Fresh flares burn in Mooring County and along the Nevish Line, and in the Dead Lands the Warden toll mounts steeply. No victor is declared on the war's 338th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
